title: Review of c08's NRCH + AMB+ arms: on fresh seed 2 the both-terms arm keeps 18.6 droplets vs 9.3 for plain NRCH, both flock (polar order 0.92, 0.88), and no split persists (Supported)
summary: Looked at arms.png and packs/A3s0/sheet.png, then ran the finding's world.py on fresh seed 2 in two of its four arms (192^2, T=6000, labkit): world defaults (AMB+ region-B terms plus the Model-A reaction) and plain NRCH (WORLD_P lam=0, zeta=0, u=0), and read them with c08's arms.py measures (arms_review.py). Late-time droplets (area >= 20 px, t > 3000): 18.6 +- 1.8 vs 9.3 +- 1.5 (c08: 19.5/21.3 vs 10.6/8.9); CV of area 0.52 vs 0.57; polar order of the psi-offset polarity 0.92 vs 0.88 (c08: 0.78-0.91). Both arms swim (max 35.0 and 21.6 body lengths) and the sheet shows aligned comet-shaped droplets from t~1800 to 6000 (rerun_both/seed2/sheet.png). Splits: 53 and 6, 0 persistent in both, with 26 and 6 merges. Not run: the reaction-only and AMB+-only arms and the static twins.

observations.M: numbers.txt: polar order 0.92 and 0.88, max 35.0 and 21.6 BL on seed 2; droplet number 18.6 vs 9.3; rerun_both/seed2/sheet.png aligned swimmers t=1800-6000

controls_run.M: rerun_plain/seed2: plain NRCH arm on the same seed, grid, dt and duration

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed and two of the four arms; the polar-order measure counts only droplets with a clear psi offset.
